credits.title: Merri Boys
credits.overview: Set around a close-knit group of young friends, the story explores modern relationships, emotional uncertainty, and the blurred lines between companionship and romance

credits.title: Bachelor Party D'eux
credits.overview: When urban chaos erupts around them, a band of honour-bound thieves must pull off a dangerous escape together, refusing to abandon each other despite deadly obstacles in their path.

credits.title: Tolsaayam
credits.overview: 14 years later, Ranjan is back in his ancestral village for his estranged father’s final rites. But his homecoming aligns with Anthiyutsavam ,a temple festival heavy with ancient rituals and a strange, unspoken unease.

credits.title: Masthishka Maranam
credits.overview: Plunging into a virtual reminiscence challenge to assuage his sorrow, a heartbroken dad uncovers a shocking revelation about Frida Soman, his long-admired icon and globally beloved luminary.

credits.title: Madhuram Jeevamruthabindu
credits.overview: Explores Different Shades Of Human Desire Through Jessie, Ilyas, Samuel, And Bhaskaran - Each Chasing Passion, Longing, Or Curiosity In Their Own Way, Revealing How Desires Shape Life And Lead To Self-Realisation.

credits.title: Theatre: The Myth of Reality
credits.overview: In a world where solitude is a choice, a mother and her daughter have built a life of peace and devotion on a secluded island. However, a fleeting moment captured online catapults them into the glaring spotlight of social media.

credits.title: Sahasam
credits.overview: A man betrays his partner and disappears with money stolen from a cartel. Later, when the loot is invested in cryptocurrency, it becomes inaccessible due to a lost password.

credits.title: Vishesham
credits.overview: Set in the background of the densely crowded city of Cochin. A city filled with the advertisements of fertility clinics. Flavoured with humour Vishesham conveys the story of today's world of fertility treatments.

credits.title: Jai Ganesh
credits.overview: In the unforgiving shadows of sympathy, Ganesh Gangadharan, a paraplegic designer, wrestles with his inner demons, striving for a semblance of normalcy.

credits.title: Thallumaala
credits.overview: Wazim is young, carefree and often drawn to fights. But when love blooms with a star vlogger, the impact of his fists could have disastrous effects.

credits.title: Hridayam
credits.overview: Arun and Darshana are first-year engineering students and they fall in love soon after their college begins. And just as how things work generally in teenage, the road ahead isn't too easy for them. Life offers many twists and turns that they least expect.

credits.title: Virus
credits.overview: A real life account of the deadly Nipah virus outbreak in Kerala, and the courageous fight put on by several individuals which helped to contain the epidemic.

credits.title: Thattumpurath Achuthan
credits.overview: Achuthan is a jovial man who loves helping his fellow villagers. However, his life turns on its head after he receives a letter that is addressed to Lord Krishna.
